protocol.scope: Existing saved predictions only; CPU analysis; no new model inference or training changes.
protocol.position_units: m; vector MSE sums xyz, averages joints/frames/clips
protocol.spectrum: Per-clip orthonormal rFFT, correct doubled interior-bin energy; no clipping, filtering, detrending or tapering in the primary analysis.
protocol.aggregation: Equal clips, with energy ratios computed from pooled mean energies; paired take-cluster bootstrap 2000 draws.
protocol.boundaries: DC is per-clip/joint six-second mean error, not a universal sensor bias or evidence of long-term drift. Energy shares are not additive MPJPE shares or achievable improvements. Fixed-beta predictions can contain shape mismatch.
protocol.derivatives: Actual finite differences of error at 10Hz, transformed separately (59 velocity and 58 acceleration samples); their band fractions are not direct transforms of the 60-frame position spectrum.
protocol.hann_check: Only a nonzero-frequency leakage sensitivity check, not an exact decomposition of original MSE.
protocol.pooled_loss_response: Ideal box-average response; finite overlapping training blocks also have boundary effects.

translation_decomposition.note: Centroid decomposition is orthogonal algebra. Pelvis-relative diagnostics are separate, not additive components.

hann_demeaned_ac_check.note: Demean each clip/joint, apply Hann, exclude reintroduced DC; robustness check of nonzero-frequency distribution only.

linear_trend_decomposition.note: Per-joint least-squares projection within each six-second clip, not proof of long-term drift.
